strings.en: Phew. Finally I can relax.
Seriously, escaping explosions every single time is getting old.
Thank you for your hard work, Joe. Everyone must be tired as well.
Nah, we got to beat the Gyandlar.
That blew all the tiredness away!
Rom, it looks like you've achieved your goal too.
Yes. ...But Gades's last words
remain a mystery...
We'll find out soon enough. You're not planning to leave Earth now, are you,
Rom?
That's right, Brother. We've fought alongside everyone on Earth
all this way.
We can't force you, of course...
Please don't concern yourselves. We too will see this battle
through to the end.
Way to go! Just like a hero of justice!
The way he always looks so cool is annoying, but... well, I'm grateful.
Yeah. It's reassuring.
Please don't flatter us. We merely follow Master Kirai's teachings,
nothing more...
You're just Leina's attendant!
That's not it! Sure, I'm not one of Master Kirai's disciples, but
I still mean to live by his teachings.
Even if he wasn't taught the martial arts, he inherited a way of life...
Maybe that's what really matters.
...As long as it isn't something that binds people's hearts.
......Anyway, the Gyandlar are wiped out. We took a lot of wear ourselves,
so we'd better think about resupplying, Bright.
Yes. For now, let's return to the Moon and decide our next move...
Pardon the interruption. There's a message from that battleship.
From the Nadesico...? Did they pick something up?
Heh heh, maybe they've got a "Gyandlar Wipeout" party
all ready for us?
Ha ha, if so, Koji and the others'll be the first ones there.
Oh, right. If everyone's expecting it that much,
maybe we really have to throw that party sometime...
Never mind that, Yurika. This is an emergency, isn't it?
Oh! R-Right. There's a boson reaction up ahead...
A boson reaction... the Jovian Alliance.
All right, everyone to battle stations!
Ugh, first the Gyandlar, and now the Jovian guys?
Quit grumbling and let's warn everyone who's resting!
The enemy has bosoned out. One Gekigan-type robot confirmed.
Just one...?
We're receiving a transmission on an open channel.
Shaff, what about us?
Yes, we've picked it up too. Putting it through.
Earth Federation Forces... no, men of the Londo Bell team,
I have not come to fight!
That voice... Captain Bright!
Yes, is it him...?
Hear me, Londo Bell! I am of the Jupiter Sphere, Ganymede, Callisto,
Europa and Other Satellite Nations Anti-Earth United Alliance,
Assault Space Force, Superior Human Corps, Major... Tsukumo Shiratori!
I knew it, it's that anime-loving Jovian guy...?
I have not come to fight! I have come as an envoy of peace,
to negotiate with you!
Bright!
...Hm. Hoshino, any other Jovian Alliance readings?
None. No boson reactions detected, either.
...This is an unexpected turn of events...
Captain Bright, what will you do...?
He hid aboard the Nadesico once before, didn't he?
...Captain Misumaru, take him in over there. If he does turn out to be a spy,
I'd rather he didn't get a look inside the Elshank.
Understood! ...But what about the negotiations...?
I'll come over with a few others. ...Commander Hazuki, please take
command in the meantime.
Very well. Please be careful.
Relax, relax. Plenty of us would make perfect bodyguards.
Peace talks, huh... All of a sudden? Doesn't that smell fishy?
Yeah. It sounds too good to be true.
Aw, we'll know once we hear what he's got to say.
That's right... If we open our hearts and talk, I'm sure we
will be able to understand each other.
Ilbora Saro, you'd lend us a hand...?
That's right. With Hazard dead,
it's not a bad deal for you.
What a pity. Didn't you hear?
We no longer had any need for Hazard's cooperation.
Though he didn't seem to feel the same way...
...That may be so, but I know you Meganoids
also took a beating from the Earthlings... from Londo Bell,
here on Mars.
Heh heh heh... I see. You're not someone to take lightly.
...Yes. I understand, dear...
Ilbora Saro, I shall give you what you desire...
That is what Don is asking.
What I desire...?
Yes...
Since you seem to have nowhere left to go, he offers you supplies...
and a chance at the inevitable showdown with Londo Bell. So he says.
Heh... As expected of the Meganoids' leader. He sees right through me.
Fine, I'll let myself be used. It's true, all I want now is Londo Bell...
no, to settle things with him...
Don expects great things of you as well. He hopes you won't
repeat Hazard Pasha's mistake.
Hmph. Should I be saying "Aura Koros," then?
As you like.
Sooo? Are the peace talks over already?
No, no, he just came to set up the negotiations.
The real negotiations are with the Jovian fleet that's coming later.
Let's hope the talks aren't all talk... Heh heh...
Hmm... But isn't this all kinda sudden?
It's not like they've taken that much of a beating yet, right?
Now that you mention it... But I don't think that Major's
a bad guy...
I'm sure Captain Bright will fill us in on the details later.
Oh, Rain, you came too?
Yes. Domon's acting as Captain Bright's bodyguard, so I came along.
Makes sense. With him around, even if that Jovian guy
tries something funny, we've got nothing to worry about...
Oh, looks like they're done...
Then, as soon as we hear from Major Shiratori,
the Jovian representative will come here.
Yes. I'll contact them at once.
During the talks, I'll act as go-between with the Jovian ship.
I hope it all goes well. ...Fighting space pirates and
criminal organizations is more than enough for us.
Yes. We both want justice and peace
for the Earth Sphere. I'm sure it'll go well... Hm?
You're...
Ah... Hi...
Will you tell me your name this time?
Akito Tenkawa. Pilot and cook.
Oh, I nearly forgot. There's something I really want you to see.
Me?
What's that... a videotape...?
...Special Edition, Heated Battle Chapter...?
Who brings a videotape these days...?
...Without my collection, you couldn't even watch it! Be grateful!
Yeah, yeah.
Part of the negotiations or not... watching a classic anime?
My, my, quite a crowd.
People from the Elshank wanted to come too.
Somehow, a screening like this reminds me
of when I worked as a voice actress.
Why am I being dragged into this too?
Don't grumble, Domon. This is part of being a good host.
Besides, they call it scripture on Jupiter. I'm curious.
Gekiganger, specially edited by the Jovians... the Heated Battle Chapter?
That's hot... so hot...!
That's right, we've gotta watch it together and get pumped!
When Koji heard there was a cartoon screening,
he got all excited about rushing over to the Nadesico.
It's fine. If you go around saying "I'm not interested in that"
like Kyosuke, you'll never make it big.
Excellen, weren't you even more excited than Koji?
Kappei was saying he was tired, and suddenly he's full of energy.
So typical.
Jeez, what a simple guy.
So what? With all this fighting, it's been ages
since I got to watch any anime.
Ha ha ha, that's true. An old anime from Earth...
I'm looking forward to it too.
It might be fun to compare the mecha designs of the time with reality...
Still, it's kind of surprising Captain Quattro's coming.
Bernie, that's rude.
Knowing the culture of a former enemy has strategic value.
...Though I'm also simply curious.
Shrewd, or whatever... Doesn't thinking like that wear you out?
Huh, where's Minato?
Minato's over there... see?
I-I never thought the day would come when I'd watch Ge-Gekiganger
with you...
My, my, don't get so flustered. Besides, we're just
watching it with everyone.
Y-Yes! I-I'm by no means, er,
getting carried away...
Oh my... Just watching them is making me blush...
Heeey, isn't it ready yet?
All right, adjustments done! Aaand... switch on!
Then that ruin really is...
Yes. We have finally discovered the "City."
It will replenish the exhausted legacy of the ancient solar civilization,
it will transform the very meaning of our war with Earth.
But what about the peace talks with Earth?
The Supreme War Council is debating them. No doubt this will be put to
good use in silencing those who support the peace talks.
I will attend the talks myself. ...And I have a special mission for you.
A special... mission?
How was it? That animation?
Well. It was certainly thought-provoking.
But if everyone in the Jovian Alliance acts on the same ideology...
that's dangerous.
What do you mean?
...Thought control.
Huh?
Allow me to explain! Well, to put it bluntly,
it's steering everyone into thinking the same way.
Don't say you'll explain and then just blurt it out.
...But that's about the size of it.
How are things on the Nadesico?
Hiii! Things are really heating up!
Whoa, that startled me. What is?
Gekiganger is all the rage over here!
There are even plans for a Gekigan Festival!
It's like a pre-party before the peace talks...
...Sorry. Cutting the line.
So this is... thought control...
No, Princess, that's something else.
Well, it doesn't look like we'll have trouble seeing eye to eye.
Bright, what do the higher-ups say?
Right. Honestly, it seems that if this can be settled
with peace for now, that's how they'd like to end it.
That's right... If we don't have to fight,
that's for the best...
Well, we're always tearing things up. Having an opponent like that
for a change might not be so bad, huh?
Yeah... All this fighting wears everyone out...
Emergency: Jovian fleet approaching. They're contacting us.
All right, put it through.
I am the Jovian representative, Lieutenant General Kusakabe.
I am the commander of Londo Bell, Colonel Bright Noa.
We came because we too wish to start the peace talks at once.
I see.
We would like to hold the talks in one hour. Details will follow.
Understood. Until then.
It's a little hectic, but the peace talks are finally starting.
Yeah. But it'll be fine, right? Looks like that Major Shiratori
is gonna be the go-between.
...Even so, we mustn't let our guard down.
Captain Bright, what's that mean? Shiratori can't be trusted?
I think he can be trusted, personally.
...But that doesn't mean all of the Jovian Alliance can.
That's not true! All of us are striving for a single ideal,
for a single justice!
...A single justice, huh. Good timing.
You won't mind if we bring along some guards, will you, Major?
Y-Yes... but...
Relax, it's just a formality. Right, Captain Bright?
Exactly. Major Shiratori, you of all people should know
that we want peace too.
Y-Yes, of course...
Rom, I'm sorry, but I'd like you to guard the negotiating party.
I don't mind, but... wouldn't it be a problem if I'm not an Earthling?
Yeah, Rom, you're strong and all, but wouldn't Domon be better?
Because they're aliens, Captain?
Yes. We're already on good terms
with people from other worlds. Putting that front and center
should make the negotiations easier.
Then we're going too.
Aliens with psychic powers? We're perfect for it, right?
Whether Pai's brute strength is psychic or not, it's a good idea!
Wha!? ...Um... you ladies are... a little... er...
It's settled. Against the Jovians, the Dangaioh Team
is a weapon just by being there.
Oh, I get it. Jovian men are bad with girls, right?
Then I'm going too, Brother.
Hey now, Leina. This isn't a game, you know.
I'm not treating it like one! I'm Kirai Stol's daughter too, aren't I?
...All right. Then take Kenrou with you.
...Just in case.
Okay! Thanks, Brother.
Without using weapons... if things work out like this,
fighting Earth's crisis alongside the Jovians might not be a dream...
True, it's rude to assume only the worst.
Let's get ready right away. Major Shiratori, are the talks on that ship?
Yes, our fleet's flagship, the Yumemizuki.
Ow, my legs are going numb. Hey... can I sit cross-legged?
That's bad manners, Pai. And stop sitting cross-legged. Just stop.
...Leina. Um... what's with that outfit?
It's supposed to be a kind of Earth uniform. Captain Misumaru said...
(I don't think that's what she meant...)
Hey, all this whispering is rude, everyone...!
Sorry, Mia. ...Huh?
......What is this......
What on earth is this!?
A document we drafted so the peace talks would go smoothly.
No, this is no peaceful document!
Earth Sphere disarmament, breaking up conglomerates, new politics...
Huh? What's that supposed to mean?
This is... colonization...!? They just aren't using force...
This is no different from the Bunker...!
...Are we to take these as your terms for peace...?
Correct.
N-No way......
Don't screw with us!
I request that this document be withdrawn.
Shiratori.........!?
State your reason, Major Shiratori.
My reason is......
they love Gekiganger too. That is my reason.
Shiratori......
On the way here, I watched Gekiganger again with them.
It's a wonderful cartoon.
Effort, victory, friendship... and love!
Everything that matters as a human being is in that work!
It's because they realized that, too, that they came seeking peace.
Shiratori...
Justice... there should only be one justice!!
......Yes. Just as you say, there is only one justice.
......! Look out! Shiratori!
Ugh!
Shiratori!
Wha... Major Shiratori!?
Why...... Why did you shoot him!?
Evil empires are destroyed by justice. That's how Gekiganger ends, too.
What...?
The evil empire deserves its fate. That's the theme of the whole work.
So Earth, which oppressed us and drove us to Jupiter, deserves to fall!
No...! How is that a reason to shoot Shiratori!?
You're saying we're the evil empire!?
Yes! There is only ever one justice. And it is on our side!
You're wrong! That isn't justice!
You're just... bending that anime to fit your own ideology!
What did you say!?
Who cares about that!? Help him... please help Shiratori!
Hmph, say what you like!
The claims of evil Earthlings aren't worth hearing!
...Guards! Seize these...
Don't move!
Wh-What...!? A beam... from her finger...!?
Wow! Oh right, the Dangaioh Team...!
That's right.
They didn't almost sell us off as human weapons for nothing!
Shiratori! Hang in there!
Out of the way, Tenkawa! I'll carry him! ...Roll!
I'll run ahead and secure an escape route! Hurry!
Got it. The talks have broken down! We're getting out!
Ngh... After them!
How... how could this happen!? Leina, you hurry too!
I'll guard the rear...!
(...Why would aliens go this far for the evil Earthlings...!?)
The Earthlings who shot Major Shiratori are escaping!
After them! You're cleared to fire!
Kenrou, please... lend me your strength...!
Shiratori... Shiratori...!!
Calm down, Minato... I've given him emergency treatment for now.
So... is he gonna be okay!?
...It's hard to say. We can manage transfusions and such, but
the damage to his internal organs is worse than I thought.
No way! Isn't there anything you can do?
If we hurry back to the Moon, we might make it in time...
But even then, there's no guarantee...
No! I won't accept that!
Dammit! Those Jovian bastards...
Shooting their own guy just for opposing them on peace...
...No, they may have meant to kill Major Shiratori from the start...
Wha...!? Why would they wanna kill their own comrade!?
Yeah, yeah! That ain't right!
...Because his death has value.
Value...!?
Yeah. It seems they... intend to make use of his death.
No way...! They're gonna say we killed Shiratori...
That's right. Not that I'm the least bit happy to be right...!
Those Jovian bastards, pulling a dirty trick like that...!
I don't care about any of that! Whether he was used or not...
Never mind that, I want him to live... I want him to live!
If I hadn't been so selfish and had let my brother go instead...!
Leina... you're safe. But...
Don't blame yourselves too much, Leina, Rom.
...We lost because we couldn't read their true intentions.
Hey, Shiratori's gonna get better, right? Right, Dr. Inez?
...I'm sorry, Kappei... I can only tell you the truth.
...We have to repair the damaged organs, or else transplant them.
But... even back on the Moon, there may not be a compatible donor...
Nooo! I finally... finally got to see him again...
Minato...
......There is.
Huh? Banjo?
...There is...... a way. ......On Mars.
On Mars...? But the colony base can't match the Moon's facilities...
That's right. Or do you mean something else...?
Yes... On Mars... their base
should have the technology and materials to replace human tissue...
Their...... I see, the Meganoids!
Meganoid technology was originally created
to evolve humanity by turning people into cyborgs...
That's not evolution!! Absolutely not!
......But... as things stand now, that technology is all we can turn to...
Banjo......
Then let's hurry! Major Shiratori's life is hanging by a thread.
And I doubt the Meganoids will welcome us with open arms.
Do we know where the Meganoid base is?
Judging from what we saw on our last trip to Mars, Koros...
no, Don Zauser, must be building his headquarters near the polar ruins.
There, he's sure to have facilities that can save Major Shiratori.
...If we can pin down the location, we should just barge right in.
Barge right in...?
A blitz, a surprise attack on the Meganoid headquarters...
Interesting! It's worth a try!
Then let's hurry back too.
For Shiratori's sake, we'll blast those Meganoid guys to bits!
Then, Dr. Inez, we'll leave the rest to you.
Yes... but please hurry.
Whatever treatment we choose... the next few hours are critical.
A few hours...? He's... in that much danger...
All right, everyone, hurry back to the Elshank.
(...Meganoid technology... but to save a life... it must be forgivable...)
Ugh... ugh... M-Minato...
Shiratori!
Minato! Anyway, get Shiratori to the Nadesico!
Akatsuki! Let's get ready too!
R-Right. ...Oh, I just remembered something I have to do.
I'll be right there, so go on ahead.
Got it. Hurry up!
Well, I'd better hurry and take care of my business too...
(If everyone in Londo Bell is going to attack the Meganoid headquarters...
then of course the Meganoids holding the ruins will be stretched thin...)
